title: Potassium for Blood Pressure
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for potassium for blood pressure.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports potassium’s role in lowering blood pressure, especially from high-quality randomized controlled trials and meta-analyses.
